understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked + in each level, while avoiding spike tiles; complete all levels to win the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Horizontal MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT reposition the player, after which gravity automatically carries the player in its current direction until landing, hitting a hazard, or reaching the goal. Gravity direction determines whether the player falls toward smaller or larger y-values. Landing on spikes ends the attempt. CLICK removes a specified clickable breakable tile without changing the player position, and does not advance the rising-platform timer; clicks should open useful gravity passages. UNDO reverts the previous action. Each level allows two attempts of up to 50 turns.
